ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New business, Closed won and later stages need Amount and Close date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_business", CASE(StageName, "Qualified", 1, "Discovery", 2, "Solution fit", 3, "Technical validation", 4, "Proposal", 5, "Negotiation (New business)", 6, "Contract out", 7, "Closed won", 8, 0) >= 8, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(CloseDate)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount and Close date before moving to Closed won.
